genie_space_detail.title: [hlsws] Brickwell Medical Mfg — Manufacturing Agent
genie_space_detail.description:
Brickwell Medical manufacturing agent — KPI analytics and troubleshooting on one lakehouse.

**Operational gold (alarms, quality history, parts):**
- `gold_alarm_playbook` — fault events with alarm_message, possible_cause, remedy_summary, manual citation
- `gold_active_alarms` — currently active faults only; demo anchor EVT-DEMO-001
- `gold_ncmr_symptom_history` — closed NCMRs ranked by recency_rank per station + symptom_tag
- `gold_spare_part_availability` — spare parts with quantity_on_hand and applicable machine_ids

**Metric views (KPI analytics):**
- `mv_quality_yield` — first pass yield %, scrap rate %, scrappage units by station/day
- `mv_station_fault_rates` — unplanned stops, downtime minutes, availability %, OEE proxy %
- `mv_machine_mttr_proxy` — fault count and MTTR by machine and error code
- `mv_symptom_scrappage` — scrappage units and NCMR count by symptom tag

**Maintenance + ML:**
- `cmms_work_orders` — technician-attended stops with minutes_to_restore (true MTTR from the CMMS)
- `gold_fault_risk_scores` — long-stop risk per fault event: long_stop_probability = P(restore > 45 min) from the long_stop_risk model, risk_band High/Medium/Low

**Do not use** `gold_station_daily_summary` or `gold_symptom_scrappage_daily` — the MVs above are the governed source.

Plants: **Eastport** (CNC Bender) and **Riverton** (forming, feed, weld lines).

routines_rows.full_data_type: (ecr_id STRING, title STRING, status STRING, risk_class STRING, affected_part_id STRING, part_name STRING, criticality STRING, min_days_of_supply DOUBLE, supplier_risk STRING)
routines_rows.comment: For an Engineering Change Request, expands every affected part and returns its criticality, inventory days-of-supply and supplier risk to support change decision making.
routines_rows.routine_definition:
SELECT e.ecr_id, e.title, e.status, e.risk_class, e.affected_part_id, p.part_name, p.criticality,
         MIN(i.days_of_supply) AS min_days_of_supply, s.risk_rating AS supplier_risk
  FROM (SELECT ecr_id, title, status, risk_class, explode(affected_parts) AS affected_part_id
        FROM ecr WHERE ecr_id = in_ecr_id) e
  JOIN parts_master p ON e.affected_part_id = p.part_id
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON e.affected_part_id = i.part_id
  LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
  GROUP BY e.ecr_id, e.title, e.status, e.risk_class, e.affected_part_id, p.part_name, p.criticality, s.risk_rating
routines_rows.schema_comment: Acme MedTech (Acme MedTech) Agentic AI + Unity AI Gateway workshop. SYNTHETIC data only.

routines_rows.full_data_type: (part_id STRING, part_name STRING, subsystem STRING, criticality STRING, revision STRING)
routines_rows.comment: Parts present in the Engineering BOM but missing from the Manufacturing BOM (EBOM to MBOM reconciliation gaps that speed up change decisions).
routines_rows.routine_definition:
SELECT e.part_id, p.part_name, p.subsystem, p.criticality, e.revision
  FROM ebom e JOIN parts_master p ON e.part_id = p.part_id
  LEFT JOIN mbom m ON e.part_id = m.part_id
  WHERE m.part_id IS NULL
routines_rows.schema_comment: Acme MedTech (Acme MedTech) Agentic AI + Unity AI Gateway workshop. SYNTHETIC data only.

routines_rows.full_data_type: (part_id STRING, part_name STRING, criticality STRING, total_on_hand INT, min_days_of_supply DOUBLE, supplier_name STRING, supplier_risk STRING, lead_time_days INT, risk_flag STRING)
routines_rows.comment: Material impact and planning risk for a part: inventory position, supplier risk, lead time and an overall AT RISK / WATCH / OK flag.
routines_rows.routine_definition:
SELECT p.part_id, p.part_name, p.criticality, CAST(SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS INT), MIN(i.days_of_supply),
         s.supplier_name, s.risk_rating, p.lead_time_days,
         CASE WHEN MIN(i.days_of_supply) < 10 OR s.risk_rating = 'High' THEN 'AT RISK'
              WHEN MIN(i.days_of_supply) < 25 THEN 'WATCH' ELSE 'OK' END
  FROM parts_master p
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.part_id = i.part_id
  LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
  WHERE p.part_id = in_part_id
  GROUP BY p.part_id, p.part_name, p.criticality, s.supplier_name, s.risk_rating, p.lead_time_days
routines_rows.schema_comment: Acme MedTech (Acme MedTech) Agentic AI + Unity AI Gateway workshop. SYNTHETIC data only.

routines_rows.comment: Executes Python code in a stateless sandboxed environment and returns its stdout. The runtime cannot access files or read previous executions' output. All operations must be self-contained, using only standard Python libraries. Calls to other tools are prohibited.

parameters_rows.comment: Python code to execute. Ensure that all variables are initialized within the code, and import any necessary standard libraries. The code must print the final result to stdout. Do not attempt to access files or external systems.
